name: royaletools
description: Use RoyaleTools public website tools to research Clash Royale decks, players, clans, upgrades, rankings, guides, and practice activities.

interface.longDescription: A Clash Royale companion for players who want help choosing decks, understanding public player and clan data, planning upgrades, and practicing the game through RoyaleTools. Find observed decks that fit your cards, compare alternatives, build Clan Wars decks, and understand competitive trends. Also find guides, creators, community activities, minigames, puzzles, and the partner-powered Merge Tactics builder. This plugin supplies website navigation skills and uses the page-reading or interactive browser tools available in your chat. Interactive workflows require browser access; otherwise it provides a relevant link and instructions. Saved decks and entered resource balances belong to the browser where they were saved. Public lookups do not require a RoyaleTools account. Deck observations are not win rates or guarantees. RoyaleTools is an unofficial fan-made service by Dcmat and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Supercell.
defaultPrompt: Find a Clash Royale deck that fits my card collection.
Improve my eight-card deck while keeping my favorite cards.
Help me plan my next upgrades and Clan Wars decks.
